description: Close a tab in the user's browser window by index, or the AI-active tab if no index is given. Use this to clean up after you're done with a research tab and don't need it anymore. Refused on the qwen-web TUI tab and on a tab the user is currently looking at.

index.description: Zero-based index of the tab to close. Defaults to the current active tab.

name: playwright_close_tab
